Claude Code isn't tired after an hour. Its context is full 🧠

I checked my own logs: after one hour, my typical session held almost half a million tokens. The docs say it plainly, performance drops as the context fills up.

The fix is 4 commands: /context to see what fills it, /compact with what to keep, /clear for a new task, /resume to get the old chat back.

Comment CONTEXT and I'll send you all four.

#claudecode #claude #ai #coding #vibecoding
claude code isn't getting dumber, its context is full 🧠 these 4 commands fix it #claudecode #claude #ai #coding #vibecoding

If Claude Code feels dumber after an hour, it's not tired. Its context is full. My own logs: after one hour my typical session held almost 500K tokens. /context shows what fills it, /compact keeps what matters, /clear starts fresh, /resume brings the old chat back.
